name: Hear dictation
description: Gives a live dictation (speech:listen) more of the speaker's audio, as raw 16-bit little-endian mono PCM at its sample rate, and returns what has been heard so far: settled, the words up to the last pause, which stay; partial, the words still being spoken, which may change; and text, the two together. With end, everything left settles, partial is empty and the dictation closes. Nothing is stored. A transcript may mishear names and numbers.

id.description: The dictation, as speech:listen returned it.

bytes.description: More audio, base64-encoded raw PCM; half a second or so at a time keeps the words close behind the speaker.

end.description: The speaker has finished: settle the rest and close the dictation.
